title: GrantPack: grant, grid-application and handover paperwork for one- to five-person heat-pump and solar installers
summary: Small UK heat-pump and solar installers carry the paperwork for the Boiler Upgrade Scheme grant, grid (DNO) applications and MCS certification for every job. Full installer CRMs cost hundreds of pounds a month. GrantPack is a light tool that turns survey notes and photos into the grant claim, the G98/G99 application and the customer handover pack.
hook: "I'm an installer, not an admin. Every heat pump means a grant claim, an MCS pack and sometimes a G99 that bounces back for one missing drawing."
story:
**Gareth is a heat-pump installer with one apprentice and a part-time admin.** For each job he must show the **£7,500 grant deducted on the quote**, raise the Boiler Upgrade Scheme voucher, collect the customer's confirmation, complete MCS commissioning records and give a handover pack. If the job includes a battery or bigger inverter, he may also need a **G99 grid application**, which only starts the 45-working-day clock once it is complete.

He looked at installer CRMs, but the full platforms cost **£199 a month and more** and want to run his whole business. He only wants the paperwork done right first time from his survey notes and photos.
whyNow: Ofgem reworked the Boiler Upgrade Scheme on 28 April 2026 and updated installer guidance again in October 2026 (V5.2). MCS is moving installers to its redeveloped scheme through 2026–2027. Heat-pump installs fell 22% in H1 2026, so small installers are watching every cost and hour.
evidence: The BUS is installer-led: the installer handles the grant paperwork and carries the cash-flow gap until redemption [Gas Engineer Software / Reonic]

whyReal.title: Paperwork on every job
whyReal.text: Grant claim, MCS records, handover pack and often a grid application: each job carries several documents with strict rules.

whyReal.title: Rules keep changing
whyReal.text: BUS guidance changed several times in 2026 and MCS is being redeveloped, so small firms struggle to keep up.

whyReal.title: Mistakes cost cash
whyReal.text: A rejected grant or incomplete G99 delays payment or switch-on, and the installer carries the cost.

whyReal.title: But the market is crowded
whyReal.text: Payaca, autarc, Reonic, Zigaflow and others already sell installer software with these features.

solution.title: Survey to job
solution.text: upload survey notes, photos and product choices; AI fills the job record.

solution.title: Grant claim
solution.text: checks eligibility rules and drafts the BUS quote wording and voucher data.

solution.title: Grid check
solution.text: decides G98 vs G99 from export capacity and drafts the application with the required data and drawings list.

solution.title: Handover pack
solution.text: commissioning records, warranties and customer documents in one PDF.

solution.title: Rule updates
solution.text: we track Ofgem, MCS and DNO changes and update checklists.
